rationale: The text establishes content management, user-facing content/function controls, collaboration, and knowledge sharing, but does not explain whether personalized/tailored experiences rely on conventional controls or potentially AI-dependent selection. No affirmative AI signal appears; non_ai is the best-supported forced judgment.
evidence_spans: Create personalized digital experiences at scale with a core set of technologies that allow you to define, standardize, and tailor unique online experiences that connect with your audience.
A complete set of tools that help you manage content, control what content and functions your users see, and enables everyone in your organization to collaborate and share knowledge more effectively.
conflict_response: The content-management and collaboration functions are explicit, and I do not infer recommendations or segmentation from personalization language. However, the description leaves how tailoring/personalization works unresolved, so the whole negative cannot be treated as supported; retain non_ai weak/forced.
